svg.text: Run Microsoft’s documented safe onboarding test
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 VMware console and the linked Microsoft detection-test article
Open Microsoft’s current Run a detection test article from the source link. Read the command
and its purpose before copying the vendor-provided test onto APP01 only. The documented test
simulates a suspicious pattern; it is not permission to download live malware.
Keep the VMware console open. Use only the current approved test on your authorized pilot; do
not add blanket AV exclusions or change machine-wide execution policy to force an alert.
Wait for telemetry and find the corresponding test alert. Microsoft describes about ten minutes
for the documented test, but treat delayed or missing reporting as a check to investigate, not
Check: A real vendor-test alert or a documented unresolved reporting failure is recorded.
